snippet.title: Subnautica 2 | Dev Vlog - Road to Early Access
snippet.description:
Welcome Aboard, Captain! 🫡 

Subnautica 2 Design Lead, Anthony Gallegos, invites you to join us on the Road to Early Access, as we share some enticing glimpses at what you can expect from the game later in 2025 🚀
